title: EIB Working Paper 2025/04 - How does digitalisation support firms’ strategies for climate change mitigation and adaptation
bookshelves: Category: Economics, Finance, Business and Management
summary: This publication examines how digitalisation supports firms in developing effective climate change mitigation and adaptation strategies. Drawing on extensive survey data, it highlights that digitally advanced firms are more likely to pursue integrated, high-impact climate actions across sectors and regions. The findings underscore the importance of fostering digital transformation to accelerate sustainable business practices and enhance climate resilience.
